events.name: Dr. Jekyll & Mr. Hyde (1920) Played by David Marsh
events.info: Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde (1920) Witness one of silent cinema's most chilling performances in Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde! John Barrymore delivers a mesmerizing transformation in this dark tale of science gone horribly wrong, as a brilliant doctor unleashes his sinister alter ego with shocking consequences that spiral beyond his control. Join us for this gripping and gothic masterpiece featuring live organ accompaniment tailored to the film by David Marsh. Arrive early and stay late for fun and informative activities! This screening is part of our Silent Movie Mondays series at the Balboa Theatre. Join us at this historic venue and step back a century, when audiences cheered, the organ came alive, and silent films glowed on the big screen. Learn more at sandiegotheatres.org.

events.name: Lila Downs - Dia de Muertos
events.info: Celebrate Día de Muertos with internationally acclaimed, GRAMMY®- and Latin GRAMMY®-winning Mexican American artist Lila Downs in an unforgettable live performance. Renowned for her commanding voice, bold artistry, and magnetic stage presence, Downs is joined by her exceptional band for a powerful program of original works and beloved traditional songs. Singing in Spanish, English, and the Indigenous languages of her native Oaxaca, she honors and elevates the rich cultural traditions of Mexico with authenticity and emotional depth. This is a vibrant, deeply moving celebration of Día de Muertos - where memory, heritage, and music come together in a performance that is both reverent and electrifying.

generalInfo.childRule: All ages must have their own ticket in same section as parent / adult. Please be considerate & use discretion when bringing young children to any theatre event. Check with San Diego Theatres at icketing@sandiegotheatres.org for any age-specific restrictions or questions.
